# Popover (`popover`)

Floating panel anchored to a control.

Group: Overlays. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/overlays';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createIconButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/iconButton.d.ts`): `.mh-icon-button`: a round, icon-only button at least a touch target wide.

```ts
export function createIconButton(options: IconButtonOptions): IconButtonHandle;

export interface IconButtonOptions {
  icon: IconName | string;
  /** Required: the button's accessible name (also its tooltip). */
  label: string;
  tone?: IconButtonTone;
  size?: IconButtonSize;
  /** A filled circle (raised surface) rather than a bare glyph. */
  filled?: boolean;
  /** Toggle buttons: sets `aria-pressed`. */
  pressed?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface IconButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setIcon(icon: IconName | string): void;
  setPressed(pressed: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createPopover` (types in `dist/web/overlays/popover.d.ts`): `.mh-popover` (`role="dialog"`, not modal): a floating panel anchored to a control, for a few quick settings (a light's brightness, a filter) without leaving the page. Opens from its anchor and takes focus (the first control, or the panel); Escape closes it back to the anchor; a press outside or Tab leaving it closes it. Parts `__header`, `__title`, `__close`, `__body`.

```ts
export function createPopover(options: PopoverOptions): PopoverHandle;

export interface PopoverOptions {
  /** The control that opens the popover; it gets `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. */
  anchor: HTMLElement;
  /** Visible heading; also the accessible name. */
  title?: string;
  /** Accessible name when there's no title. */
  label?: string;
  content?: Child | Child[];
  /** Default `bottom`; flips when there's no room. */
  placement?: FloatingPlacement;
  /** A close button beside the title. Default false (Escape and a press outside close it). */
  closeButton?: boolean;
  closeLabel?: string;
  /** Clicking the anchor opens and closes it. Default true; false leaves opening to `open()`. */
  toggleOnClick?: boolean;
  /** Width: `auto` (content, capped), or `wide` for forms. */
  size?: 'auto' | 'wide';
  /** Portals into the nearest `[data-mh-theme]` ancestor of this element (default: the anchor's). */
  container?: HTMLElement | null;
  onOpen?: () => void;
  onClose?: (reason: PopoverCloseReason) => void;
}

export interface PopoverHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  body: HTMLElement;
  open(): void;
  close(): void;
  toggle(): void;
  isOpen(): boolean;
  setTitle(title: string): void;
  setContent(...children: Child[]): void;
  /** Places it again (after its content changed size). */
  reposition(): void;
  /** Closes it and detaches it and its listeners from the anchor. */
  destroy(): void;
}
```

`h` (types in `dist/web/dom.d.ts`): Creates an element: string and number attributes are set, `true` sets an empty attribute, `on*` functions become listeners.

```ts
export function h<K extends keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap>(tag: K, attrs: Attrs = {}, ...children: Child[]): HTMLElementTagNameMap[K];
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createIconButton, createPopover, h } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = h('p', { 'aria-live': 'polite' });
const info = createIconButton({ icon: 'info', label: 'About this sensor' });

// Pressing the anchor opens and closes it.
createPopover({
  anchor: info.el,
  title: 'Air quality',
  content: h('p', {}, 'Measured every five minutes in the hallway. Readings under 50 are good.'),
  onOpen: () => (status.textContent = 'Showing details'),
  onClose: () => (status.textContent = ''),
});

document.body.append(info.el, status);
```

## React API

`IconButton` (types in `dist/react/actions.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createIconButton`.

```ts
export function IconButton({ icon, label, tone, size, filled, pressed, className, ...rest }: IconButtonProps);

export interface IconButtonProps extends Omit<ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'children'> {
  icon: IconName | string;
  /** Required: the accessible name (also the tooltip). */
  label: string;
  tone?: IconButtonTone;
  size?: IconButtonSize;
  filled?: boolean;
  pressed?: boolean;
}
```

`Popover` (types in `dist/react/overlays.d.ts`): `createPopover` on `trigger`, with `children` portalled into its body. The trigger's wrapper is `display: contents`.

```ts
export function Popover({ trigger, title, label, placement, closeButton, closeLabel, size, open, onOpenChange, children }: PopoverProps);

export interface PopoverProps {
  /** The control that opens it: one element (it gets `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`). */
  trigger: ReactElement;
  title?: string;
  label?: string;
  placement?: FloatingPlacement;
  closeButton?: boolean;
  closeLabel?: string;
  size?: 'auto' | 'wide';
  /** Follows this when it changes; leave it out to let the trigger open and close it. */
  open?: boolean;
  /** It opened or closed (from the trigger, Escape, a press outside, Tab leaving it, or the close button). */
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean, reason?: PopoverCloseReason) => void;
  /** The panel's content. */
  children?: ReactNode;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { IconButton, Popover } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function PopoverExample() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <>
      <Popover
        trigger={<IconButton icon="info" label="About this sensor" />}
        title="Air quality"
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={setOpen}
      >
        <p>Measured every five minutes in the hallway. Readings under 50 are good.</p>
      </Popover>
      <p aria-live="polite">{open ? 'Showing details' : ''}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```
